structured_output.what_is_happening: "Desk", a pump.fun token launched through the uxento Discord deploy tool, is 45 minutes old and still on its bonding curve (104 of about 115 virtual SOL). It is up about 1000% in its first hour on $160k of volume. That is about 7x turnover against roughly $35-39k market cap. Buys outnumber sells about 1.5:1 and unique buyers (917) outnumber unique sellers (715). It links to agentdesk.fun and @Agentdeskonsol, and the name suggests an AI-agent theme. Two copycat "Agent Desk" tokens appeared within minutes of launch. GMGN tags 201 of 362 traders as bundler wallets, and bundlers make up about 32% of top traders. Bot/degen share is 51%. The dev has already sold out (creator_close). It is close to graduating to PumpSwap.

narrative.description: The name suggests an AI 'agent desk' tool with a website and X account, launched through the uxento Discord. The theme is generic but still popular in Solana microcaps. There is no visible sign of an outside catalyst.
narrative.why_spreading: The spread looks like launchpad/Discord flow, bundled buying and bots, which pull in degens chasing a coin near graduation. Copycat 'Agent Desk' tokens show some attention, but that attention comes from snipers, not from organic followers.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the only DESK token with real volume and curve depth. It launched first, before the 'Agent Desk' copycats, and it carries the project website and X links.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Several DESK/Agent Desk clones launched within minutes. All are at about $3k market cap with zero liquidity, which looks like copycat sniping. There are also older, dead Deskcoin/Coindesk tokens.

authenticity.evidence: 201 of 362 traders are tagged as bundler wallets, and 32% of top traders are bundlers. Bot/degen share is 51% and 206 wallets are fresh. The launch came through a Discord deploy tool. A community-takeover flag is already set at 45 minutes old, and the dev has sold out. The 1.5:1 buy/sell ratio is plausibly padded by bundlers.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data. Bundler tags on pump.fun sometimes pick up normal trading-bot users. The top-10 holdings of 18.85% are fairly spread out, which argues against one whale dumping.

structural_risks: Heavy bundler presence means supply is likely to be dumped into the curve and at migration
Near graduation: pump.fun coins often sell off hard right after migrating to PumpSwap
The dev sold everything and has a history of 3 launches with a best all-time high of about $56k
Entry comes 25 minutes after a +1000% hour, which risks buying the top
Doubling from about $40-45k to about $90k needs demand after graduation, which is uncommon for Discord-launched coins

structured_output.counterargument: It is close to graduation, has a real website and X account, draws strong unique-buyer counts (917), has fairly spread-out holders, has attracted copycats (a sign of attention), and 6 smart wallets are in. Coins that graduate with momentum at around $40k can easily reach $100k+ in a burst. Doubling from a low entry is a small absolute move.

structured_output.thesis: This is a bundled launch from a Discord deploy tool with a generic AI-agent name. The dev has already sold out and bundler presence is heavy. It is approaching graduation after a +1000% hour, a setup that usually ends with bundlers dumping at or after migration rather than a sustained 2x from a delayed entry. It has a real chance of spiking through graduation, but that is below break-even.
